rules: No Inter or default sans-serif for headings.
Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase, tiny, and wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Line height: tight for headers (leading-none), loose for body (leading-relaxed).
Color is Function Only: 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action or indicate status.
Tinted Grey Rule: Tint neutral greys with a tiny bit of blue to make them feel alive (zinc/slate).
Hover states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default.

layout_and_spacing.containers: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical Alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content, forms, tabular data.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Rounded-none (0px) or very sharp rounded-sm (max 4px). No soft/pill shapes.

surfaces_and_microthemes.dashboard_cards: Grid Borders variant. Container with border-collapse style. Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color darkens.
surfaces_and_microthemes.headers: Solid Background with a hard bottom border. If content scrolls, use Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px delicate inner stroke).
surfaces_and_microthemes.footers: Massive Space. py-20. Big Type for main CTA.

components.tables: Shadcn UI Tables. Use monospace font (IBM Plex Mono) for numeric data, dates, and IDs. Dense padding.
components.forms: Shadcn UI Form components. Never use native inputs. Sharp corners.
components.buttons: Shadcn UI. High contrast. Primary CTA uses #0055FF, other buttons outlined or ghost. Text always visible.
components.charts: Shadcn chart components (Recharts). Accessible color-blind-friendly palettes using the accent colors.
components.modals: Solid white background, sharp border, backdrop-blur on the overlay.
components.dialogs: Shadcn UI dialogs. Use them for assigning disciplines to sub-consultants.
components.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-rfp-button').

animations.lists: Staggered entrance animations for RFP lists and extracted requirements.

icons.style: Duotone or bold weights to match the high-contrast technical aesthetic.

media_and_images.strategy: Minimalist imagery. Let data and typography be the focus. Use blueprint visuals for login/signup backgrounds or empty states.

urls.description: Architectural blueprint layout for login/signup screen background or hero empty state.
Blueprint drawing of tall building to be used in empty dashboard states.

media_and_images.constraints: Mobile height limit: Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile devices. Overlay max opacity bg-black/50 for text contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts (Satoshi, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono) and Phosphor Icons: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
Configure Tailwind with the provided color palette, exact fonts, and sharp border radiuses.
Ensure high-contrast styling is applied. Use zinc colors for neutrals.
Structure the dashboard using the 'Control Room' dense grid approach. No generic Bootstrap columns.
For tables (Fee Merger View, Extracted Requirements), utilize monospace for numerical values.
Implement data-testid on every interactive component for testing.
Keep standard pages aligned left, no center-everything disease.
Incorporate Sovrium's technical, configuration-heavy aesthetic: visible structural borders, raw layout lines, and documentation-like neatness.
